implemented_api_before_this_task: session.rs::submit_geometry_text parsed one hard-coded assignment by hand: it split on '=', required the key to be exactly BothSides (no trimming), accepted only yes/no, and refused every other assignment with one generic message
gap_found_by_this_task: No numeric options and no units: length=2.5mm / angle=90deg (the oracle) could not be typed at all.
The hand-written key check did not trim, so ' BothSides = No ' (a legitimate spelling, and the whole text IS trimmed first only at the outside) was refused as an unknown option.
Nothing refused NaN/Infinity as option values because no numeric option existed; the parser now reads them as numbers first and refuses them as non-finite.

Added option_parser.rs (pure): parse_option(operation, text) reads a flag or a number with a unit, names the declared spelling, and refuses unknown names, malformed numbers, non-finite values, unknown units, empty names and empty values, each with its own error.
Session wiring: BothSides sets the flag (through the parser, so padding and case are accepted), Length fixes the end point's distance from the start and the click chooses the direction.
reuse_decision: ADAPT the keyed typed parameter idea of qymcad-ui-state; ADD the textual option language with units and the named refusals.
